scope: Review and deterministic core diagnostics; no production changes, Android build or phone operations.
source_category_control: In both POJ and Japanese, swapping only the category assigned to the same two readings/outputs reverses their order.

data_roles.partial: 32 SHA-256-order-selected lowercase partial inputs of length 3–16 from the already exposed WanaKana oracle; each in lowercase, uppercase, title case and with ka- prepended. Full production add-ons and Japanese basics are loaded. Candidate consumed span is compared with remaining owned raw input after explicit selection. Tests acceptance mechanics, not Japanese meaning.
data_roles.continuation: 32 SHA-256-order-selected distinct single-word contexts of length 2–16 from existing English context.tsv. Explicit raw selection identifies English unambiguously. Same static provider and input across four modes; no output labels enter ranking. Source-derived capability check, not accuracy.
data_roles.category: Two artificial lexical identities with equal scores/readings and unchanged row order. Swap only ordinary/expression category metadata. Diagnostic fixtures never enter production.

limitations: Partial probes do not exercise native Rime, async Android rendering or physical gestures.
Learning callbacks are recorded by a spy, not Android persistence. Existing phone persistence tests remain separate evidence.
No new coverage or latency benchmark is claimed. Prior measurements have their original revisions/genres/endpoints.
The confirmed suffix-loss defect remains present in 0.8.2; this review does not patch it.
